scribe_mix.text: Erythrocytes, red blood cells. Most abundant of all the cells in blood. Healthy adult man and on an average has five to five point five millions of RBCs per cubic millimeter. These formed in the red bone marrow. Nucleus devoid in most mammals. Biconcave in shape. Hemoglobin, iron-containing complex protein. Red colored, hence the color, hence the name. Hemoglobin, grams in every hundred ml, twelve to sixteen. Transport of respiratory gases. Lifespan, one hundred twenty days. Destroyed in the spleen, graveyard of RBC. Hemoglobin, iron-containing complex protein. Red colored, hence the color, hence the name. Erythrocytes, red blood cells.
